name.fr-FR: La Mère du Sauveur et notre vie intérieure (traduction anglaise)
name.en-US: The Mother of the Saviour and Our Interior Life
name.pt-BR: A Mãe do Salvador e a nossa vida interior (tradução inglesa)

description.en-US: Mariology in the service of the interior life: Mary’s predestination and divine maternity, her fullness of grace, her mediation and her motherhood of souls, and her part in the soul’s progress to union. Bernard J. Kelly’s translation of La Mère du Sauveur et notre vie intérieure (1941), Golden Eagle Books, Dublin 1948.
description.pt-BR: A mariologia a serviço da vida interior: a predestinação de Maria e sua maternidade divina, a plenitude de graça, a mediação e a maternidade espiritual, e seu papel no progresso da alma até a união. Tradução inglesa de Bernard J. Kelly (Dublin, 1948) de La Mère du Sauveur et notre vie intérieure (1941).

sources.edition: The Mother of the Saviour and Our Interior Life, tr. Bernard J. Kelly, C.S.Sp., Dublin: Golden Eagle Books, 1948 (archive.org Lagrange-English); the French original is not open
